thought: Need to create a new challenge from the Create tab. Let me tap on the Create button in the bottom navigation.
I need to create a new challenge. I'm on Step 1 of 3 where I need to name the challenge. The text field is empty and ready for input. I'll tap on it and enter a simple challenge name.
I need to enter a challenge title. The field shows 'e.g. Gym before work' as a placeholder. I'll type a simple challenge name that meets the 3+ character requirement.

I've entered the challenge title 'Gym before work' and it shows 'Looks good' with 15/60 characters. Now I need to select a category. The Fitness category is perfect for a gym-related challenge. I'll tap on it.

I've set up the challenge with title 'Gym before work', category Fitness, 7 days duration, and Solo mode. Now I need to tap Continue to move to Step 2 of 3. The keyboard is still visible but I need to proceed with the challenge creation.
I'm on Step 2 of 3 where I need to pick tasks for the challenge. The user wants me to create 'one simple check-off task', so I should tap Custom to build from scratch rather than use a starter pack.
I'm on Step 2 of 3 and need to add one simple check-off task. The Custom option is already selected. I need to tap 'Add a task' to create the task for this challenge.
I'm on Step 2 of 3 adding a task. I need to enter a task name. The task name field shows placeholder text 'e.g. Read 10 pages'. I'll tap on it and enter a simple check-off task name.
I need to enter a simple check-off task name. The field is already focused (showing the keyboard). I'll type a straightforward task that can be checked off easily.

I see the task name 'Do 10 pushups' is already entered. Now I need to select 'Check off' as the action type since the goal specifies 'one simple check-off task'. Currently 'Run' is selected, so I need to tap 'Check off' to change it.

I've already set up one task 'Do 10 pushups' with Check off selected. Now I need to tap 'Add task' to finalize this task and proceed. The keyboard is still open but I should close it first or just tap Add task to move forward.
I've set up one simple check-off task 'Do 10 pushups' with Check off selected. Now I need to move to Step 3 by tapping Continue to proceed with creating this challenge.

I'm on Step 3 of 3 with Standard accountability level selected and Invite visibility selected. These settings look good for creating a challenge to share with friends. I need to tap Review to proceed to the success screen where I can find the invite link.
